CustomField.description: Opt-in. Off (the default, and how every existing org behaves): a multiselect rendered read-only shows only its selected values, or None Selected. On: a read-only multiselect shows every value, with the selected ones marked - pills in the brand color for the badge display type, checked boxes for the checkbox types - and the unselected ones greyed. Applies wherever a multiselect is read-only: conditional logic, a read-only field setting, a field that cannot be updated, or a form placed read-only.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When on, a read-only multiselect shows every value as a pill or checkbox, with the selected ones in the brand color, instead of only the selected values. Off keeps the current display: selected values only.
CustomField.label: Multiselect: Show All When Read Only
